decision.summary: No new action: the open 79k reach daily still matches the live bullish structure, but it remains below partial take-profit territory and no secondary setup is clean enough with six hours left.
decision.rationale: BTC is holding around 78.74k with bullish short-term Binance structure, so the existing 79k reach daily remains the correct thesis expression. Its market probability is only around 72%, which is still below the playbook partial take-profit band of 80-85%, so there is no reason to reduce yet. Re-adding the same market is unnecessary because the current open cash already captures the thesis and no fresh edge has appeared. A second daily or weekly position is not justified: 80k reach is too stretched for the remaining time window, while 78k dip and lower bearish contracts remain out of sync with the live bullish context and do not have clean same-day confirmation.
